verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-card amount limits: virtual cards with a set limit for each purpose, and CUSTOM VCNs with an adjustable ceiling, time window and unspecified 'controls'. It also offers purpose-specific cards (travel, software, ads) and manual block/unblock. The evidence never shows category (MCC) or merchant restrictions, nor explicitly describes declining out-of-policy spend at the point of sale. Transaction categories are only for classification and don't count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented MCC/category spend restrictions, merchant-level allow/block lists, explicit point-of-sale decline or auto-lock behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
